Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Chinese mobile casual puzzle game advertising poster, portrait 2:3, high resolution, full bleed, no collage/contact sheet, no mockup phone frame, no watermark. Game name is exactly “烦恼排排消”. Match the existing game's identity: a cozy sunlit wooden workshop, creamy ivory 8-column by 10-row grid with a thick rounded cocoa-brown frame; cute glossy soft candy/soap-like rectangular blocks, each ONE cell tall and 1, 2 or 3 cells wide, with tiny expressive dot eyes and mouths. Colors honey yellow, sage mint, coral peach, dusty pink, lime green and mist blue. A small round yellow happy-bean mascot has a tiny green leaf sprout, rosy cheeks, stubby arms and legs. This is a LEFT/RIGHT SLIDING and COMPLETE HORIZONTAL ROW clearing puzzle. Illustrate an unmistakable horizontal drag, blocks falling into gaps by gravity, then complete rows bursting. NOT match-three, NOT colored balls, NOT polyomino shapes, NOT brick breaker. Style: extremely expressive polished 3D-toon advertising illustration with tactile rounded forms, enormous elastic facial expressions, dynamic foreshortening, forceful diagonal composition and spectacular particle effects, bright bold saturated accents while maintaining the warm game palette. Visually extravagant, joyous, energetic, rich and full but with a clear hierarchy and legible gameplay; commercial art-director finish. Chinese typography must be exact, crisp, chunky, playful, dimensional, professionally integrated, clean margins about 5%. No money, cash, payouts, real-world prizes or fabricated testimonial claims. No third-party logos.
Campaign 1 of a coherent three-poster series: TOTAL CLEARING EUPHORIA. A large readable game board tilts forward in dramatic perspective across the middle/lower two-thirds. A giant foreground finger drags a peach 3-cell-wide, one-cell-high smiling block HORIZONTALLY into the final gap. Several filled horizontal rows become luminous golden bands and erupt toward camera in a cascade of candy fragments, golden happy beans, stars and comic shockwaves. A huge yellow sprout mascot flies joyfully in the foreground with laughing open mouth and wildly stretched arms; other blocks show hilariously ecstatic faces. Golden sunlight explodes behind the grid, hot coral and turquoise impact streaks at edges, strong depth and sweeping motion, super satisfying row-clearing spectacle, keep much of the board's grid and independent rectangular blocks recognizable.
Text (verbatim), only these four elements: small top game logo “烦恼排排消”; gigantic two-line headline across upper quarter “这一拖” / “爽翻了！”; one supporting line near bottom “左右拖一拖，整行消个够”; a plump yellow/coral CTA near bottom “立即开消”. Headline is the most dominant text, game logo smaller. No other text or arbitrary score numbers.
